# cheat-sheet lines for pagination, work-in-progress prefixes and merge style; source https://forgejo.org/docs/latest/admin/config-cheat-sheet/, fetched 2026-11-23
WORK_IN_PROGRESS_PREFIXES: WIP:,[WIP]: List of prefixes used in Pull Request
DEFAULT_MERGE_STYLE: merge: Set default merge style for repository creation; valid options: merge, rebase, rebase-merge, squash, fast-forward-only.
DEFAULT_PAGING_NUM: 10: The default paging number for the releases user interface.
MAX_RESPONSE_ITEMS: 50: Maximum number of items in a page.
DEFAULT_PAGING_NUM: 30: Default paging number for the API.
